api.veFlashState: vec4 veFlashState(): xyz world position, w envelope * flashStrength
api.veSurfaceLight: vec3 veSurfaceLight(vec3 world, vec3 normal): additive, bounded direct surface radiance; no terrain shadow map
api.veIntegrate: vec4 veIntegrate(vec3 origin, vec3 normalizedDirection, float opaqueDistance): rgb premultiplied radiance, alpha transmittance
api.composition: linearSceneRGB * volume.a + volume.rgb; add veSurfaceLight at opaque scene surface before volume integration

time: Time is elapsed seconds; event hash uses floor(Time / flashPeriod) and Seed. A frozen Time freezes both wind and events. No persistent history. Reload with unchanged Time/Seed replays identically. Negative Time is clamped to zero.
coordinates: World block units. Finite slab/cylinder (shape 0), sphere (shape 1), annular slab (shape 2). Bounds xyz center; Bounds.w radius. Layer xy bottom/height for 0/2; Layer.w inner radius for 2. Sphere uses centerY and radius.
limits: Single finite volume, single flash per cycle, no light propagation into block light, no terrain occlusion along local-light rays, no arbitrary transparent-layer support. Core maximum 96 view steps and 12 light steps.
